notes.title: Bonus levels for Glaive: Brick Breaker!
notes.content: Enjoy 5 new levels in 'Winter is Coming' challenges in Arcade mode.

notes.title: Glaive: Brick Breaker patch 1.01 with free content is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32384613/a61ab8a697e964d1df61d036e69de373563fe42f.jpg[/img]

- highly requested Level Creator mode - build you own stage and play it!

- new locations to play - Winter and Neon themes for game

- new powerups - blasters and force field

- new mechanic - crazy shot (earn enough power in game to fire game changing ball!)

- new brick types - try to destroy bricks that hide from you or bricks that can catch and shoot back your ball

- new unlockable skins for your Glaive

- new Endurance game mode - try to beat as many stages as you can!

- almost 100 new stages in game to play in arcade and versus!

- adjusted some game aspects for better gameplay and responsivness

- mouse controls!
